modules.description: The directory the modules are in, relative to the input root: one directory per module, `Domain`, `Application`, `Infrastructure` and `IntegrationEvents` under it. Each module is a bounded context with one service.

api.description: The directory the HTTP host is in, relative to the input root. Controllers under a `Modules/<Module>` directory beneath it are that module's HTTP edge.

database.description: The directory the database project is in, relative to the input root: `Structure/<schema>/Tables/*.sql` and `Structure/<schema>/Views/*.sql` beneath it, one schema per module.

repo.description: Where the source lives, as `host/owner/name`. Nothing in a .NET tree says, so the manifest does.

bus.description: The address of the bus integration events cross modules on. The code names the class, `InMemoryEventBus`, and nothing else, so the manifest says.

storeKind.description: What the schemas live in. SQL Server is `other`.

classification.description: Whether the modules are core to the business, support it, or are generic and could be bought. One value for every module the tree declares.

out.description: Name of the fragment file, inside the step's output directory.

openapiOut.description: Name of the inferred OpenAPI 3.1 document, inside the step's output directory, one per module with controllers; `{service}` is replaced with the module's slug.

storesOut.description: Name of the store fragment, inside the step's output directory. Written when the database project declares a schema a module maps to.
